hypothesis: The M166 1024-step anchor50 PPO micro recipe should be repeated across seeds before any longer PPO because M165 showed that a superficially safe PPO step can regress the fixed boundary replay signal.
success_criteria: run at least two additional M166-style PPO micro seeds from M163
do not continue from M165 or a failed checkpoint
keep actor inputs unchanged and hidden labels out of the actor
evaluate fixed M162 objective for every repeat
run M164 boundary replay gate for every repeat
run behavior retention and protected-key gates for the best repeat
admit longer staged PPO only if repeats preserve boundary replay success-drop count
failure_criteria: declare the single M166 seed sufficient for longer PPO
relax the M164 replay thresholds to pass a repeat
skip the fixed boundary replay gate
select a repeat only by PPO rollout reward

commands.name: m167_multiseed_ppo_micro_repeat
commands.command: Repeat the M166 PPO micro recipe across seeds and gate each repeat with M164 boundary replay.

decision_rule: Admit longer staged PPO only if repeated M166-style PPO seeds preserve behavior, protected key, and the fixed M164 boundary replay signal.
